output.question: Has General Motors announced layoffs?
output.answer: Yes. As of November 11, 2026, the most recent announcement I verified concerns 350 workers at GM’s Lansing Grand River Assembly/Stamping and Lansing Regional Stamping facilities, with layoffs scheduled to begin January 14, 2027. GM said the production downtime involves preparing the plant for the next-generation Cadillac CT5. ([wilx.com](https://www.wilx.com/2026/08/17/they-all-come-here-local-business-prepares-life-after-gm-layoffs/?outputType=amp))

key_facts.fact: As reported August 17, 2026, General Motors announced layoffs affecting 350 workers at Lansing Grand River Assembly/Stamping and Lansing Regional Stamping, effective January 14, 2027.
GM said employees would prepare Lansing Grand River for production of the next-generation Cadillac CT5 during the production downtime.

passages.quote: Starting January 14th, 2027, 350 layoffs are coming to the Lansing Grand River Assembly and Stamping plant and the Lansing Regional Stamping facility.
Our skilled-trades team will be working to prepare the plant for production of the next-generation Cadillac CT5.

caveats: These are scheduled layoffs, not confirmation that the workers have already been laid off.
I did not verify a newer announcement; this is not an exhaustive count of GM layoffs.
The Michigan WARN website opened, but its individual notice records did not load, so the details above rely on reporting quoting GM.
